title: Evidence vocabulary
description:
How strong the evidence behind a verification, a platform or a release is, in one vocabulary shared by verification-report, qa-report and release-manifest.

The status of a check (PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, WARNING) decides routing. The evidence status decides what may be claimed afterwards, and it only ever travels downstream as it was observed: a PASS_MOCK is never summed, reported or promoted as a PASS, and a portal's own QA stays BLOCKED_EXTERNAL until someone has evidence from the portal.

evidenceStatus.description: Strongest first. PASS: observed against the real thing (a command's exit code, a test report written by this run, a browser run of the built bundle). PASS_MOCK: observed only against a stand-in, such as a mocked or fake portal SDK. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: needs an outside party (a portal's own QA or review) and no evidence from it exists. UNVERIFIED: not established (a check that is BLOCKED, or a WARNING nobody evidenced). FAIL: evidence shows the requirement does not hold.

portalStatus.description: Whether behaviour on the live portal has been observed. BLOCKED_EXTERNAL unless every SDK check about the platform passed on evidence its observer describes as a live-portal observation; NOT_APPLICABLE when the pinned profile's review process is `none`. Never a statement about portal approval, which is always `not-claimed`.

workflowRef.description: Where in a Factory workflow run an artifact was produced. Lets a consumer tell this visit's artifact from an earlier one's, or another run's.
